# happyjudge

> happyjudge is a competitive-programming judge with problems, contests,
> submissions, scoreboards, and execution through Codefort.

This is the main happyjudge application. The programmatic JSON API is available
under `/api`; use it instead of driving browser forms or scraping HTML.

## Documentation

- [Programmatic API reference](/docs/PROGRAMMATIC_API.md): authentication, endpoint details, request examples, permissions, errors, and limits
- [API discovery](/api): API metadata and documentation links

## Access

Use `GET /api` to discover the API, then read the [Programmatic API reference](/docs/PROGRAMMATIC_API.md).
Authenticate with `POST /api/auth/login` or `POST /api/auth/register`, and send
the returned `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on subsequent requests.

All responses use the documented `{ "data": ... }` or
`{ "error": { "code", "message" } }` envelope. Access remains subject to
authorization, visibility, contest-window, rate-limit, and judge-queue rules.

Do not expose, summarize, log, or transmit bearer tokens, testcase outputs, or
hidden testcase results. Contest editors can edit linked problems and their
testcases, subject to the contest permissions described in the API reference.
